item.title: Self-care to Help With Winter Dry Spells
item.description: In cold weather, our hair and skin often become dry. For me personally, I struggle the most with my skin. My T-zone is oily year-round, but the surrounding area can get dry in winter. Common reasons include dry, outdoor air, low indoor humidity from heating, and insufficient water intake. To combat low humidity, I always recommend a humidifier. <p>The post Self-care to Help With Winter Dry Spells first appeared on Her Campus.</p>

item.title: The Backbone Of My World
item.description: The strongest person I know doesn’t wear a cape or stand on a stage. Her strength lives quietly, in early mornings and late nights, in sacrifices that never ask to be seen.
